requirements.title: SPREAD argument restrictions
requirements.definition: SOURCE shall be scalar or array of any type with rank less than 15, DIM shall be an integer scalar in range 1 through rank(SOURCE)+1, and NCOPIES shall be an integer scalar.

pending.SPREAD-SOURCE-scalar-or-array-any-type: Positive controls call SPREAD with integer scalar, character scalar, and rank-one integer array SOURCE values; source-control mutations use unsupported nonexpression actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPREAD-SOURCE-rank-less-than-15: Positive controls use rank-zero, rank-one, and rank-two SOURCE values; a rank-15 source-control mutation claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPREAD-DIM-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive controls use DIM=1 and DIM=rank(SOURCE)+1; source-control mutations use DIM=0, DIM=rank plus two, and noninteger DIM and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPREAD-NCOPIES-integer-scalar: Positive controls use positive, zero, and negative integer NCOPIES values; source-control mutations use real or nonscalar NCOPIES and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: SPREAD result type, rank, and shape
requirements.definition: SPREAD returns an array of the same type and type parameters as SOURCE with rank n+1; scalar SOURCE has shape (MAX(NCOPIES,0)), and array SOURCE inserts that extent at DIM.

pending.SPREAD-result-same-type-and-parameters: Use character SOURCE of length three and integer SOURCE of selected kind, assert result LEN and KIND match SOURCE, and mutate SOURCE length or kind so checks fail.
pending.SPREAD-result-rank-n-plus-one: Assert RANK(SPREAD(scalar,DIM=1,NCOPIES=2))==1 and RANK(SPREAD(rank_one,DIM=2,NCOPIES=2))==2; mutate to SOURCE alone so rank checks fail.
pending.SPREAD-scalar-source-shape: Assert SHAPE(SPREAD(7,DIM=1,NCOPIES=3))==[3] from a sentinel and mutate NCOPIES to 2 so the shape check fails.
pending.SPREAD-array-source-shape: Use rank-one SOURCE shape [3], assert DIM=1 gives shape [2,3] and DIM=2 gives shape [3,2], and mutate DIM so the expected shape fails.
pending.SPREAD-nonpositive-NCOPIES-zero-extent: Use NCOPIES=0 and NCOPIES=-2 with a positive companion; assert SIZE of each result is zero and the positive companion has nonzero size.
